title: How do you truly stand out in Tech?
why_read: This is a motivational career advice piece with no technical depth, aimed at job seekers rather than practicing engineers.
analysis: The article addresses the difficulty of standing out in a crowded tech job market, particularly for newcomers competing against laid-off senior engineers. It acknowledges there is no single answer, which is honest but also means it offers little concrete guidance. The content is personal reflection rather than technical analysis. A professional technical digest has no real use for this kind of piece.
